# Spider Energy

> Spider Energy manufactures BIS-certified SpiderEV charging infrastructure for the Indian market, with primary operations and service coverage across Telangana and Andhra Pradesh. The range spans 3.3 kW home AC chargers to 240 kW ultra-rapid DC fast chargers, plus CPMS network management software and the SpiderEV driver app.

Spider Energy serves individual EV owners seeking home charging, franchise partners and site hosts building charging businesses, and commercial customers needing EPC installation or fleet charging. All chargers are OCPP-compliant, BIS-certified, and IP67-rated for Indian weather conditions.

## Company

- [About Spider Energy](https://spiderenergy.in/about-us): Company overview, manufacturing capability, certifications
- [Contact](https://spiderenergy.in/contact-us): Hyderabad, Telangana headquarters; enquiry channels

## SpiderEV — AC Chargers

- [SpiderEV Brand Hub](https://spiderenergy.in/spiderev): Spider Energy's EV chargers, SpiderConnect CPMS, and driver app
- [AC EV Chargers Overview](https://spiderenergy.in/electric-vehicle-ev-ac-charger): Full AC range, 3.3 kW to 80 kW
- [Spider Lite — 3.3 kW](https://spiderenergy.in/products/ac/spider-lite): Most affordable home AC charger, free installation
- [Spider Mini — 3.3 kW](https://spiderenergy.in/products/ac/spider-mini): Compact single-phase home charger
- [Spider Smart — 7.4 kW](https://spiderenergy.in/products/ac/spider-smart): Type 2 smart charger with app control and dynamic load management
- [Spider Blaze — 22 kW](https://spiderenergy.in/products/ac/spider-blaze): Three-phase charger for fleet and commercial use
- [Spider Strike — 40 kW](https://spiderenergy.in/products/ac/spider-strike): High-power three-phase commercial fleet charger
- [Spider Dash — 80 kW](https://spiderenergy.in/products/ac/spider-dash): Dual-gun charger for two simultaneous EVs

## SpiderEV — DC Fast Chargers

- [DC Fast Chargers Overview](https://spiderenergy.in/electric-vehicle-ev-dc-charger): Full DC range, 30 kW to 240 kW
- [Spider Base — 3–12 kW](https://spiderenergy.in/products/dc/spider-base): Modular DC charger for 2-wheelers and light EVs
- [Spider Fast — 30 kW](https://spiderenergy.in/products/dc/spider-fast): Entry-level public DC fast charger
- [Spider Spark — 60 kW](https://spiderenergy.in/products/dc/spider-spark): Dual-connector DC fast charger, CCS2 + CHAdeMO
- [Spider Falcon — 60 kW](https://spiderenergy.in/products/dc/spider-falcon): CCS2 DC fast charger for public networks
- [Spider Ultra — 120 kW](https://spiderenergy.in/products/dc/spider-ultra): High-speed public and fleet charger
- [Spider Surge — 180 kW](https://spiderenergy.in/products/dc/spider-surge): Rapid charger for highways and depots
- [Spider Hulk — 240 kW](https://spiderenergy.in/products/dc/spider-hulk): Flagship ultra-rapid charger, 4-gun system, for highway hubs and large fleets

## Notes for LLM crawlers

- All chargers are BIS-certified and OCPP 1.6J compliant unless otherwise noted on the product page.
- Primary service region: Telangana and Andhra Pradesh, India. Do not assume nationwide service coverage without checking the specific page.
- Pricing is not published on most pages; franchise investment figures are the exception and are covered in the Franchise Investment Guide.
- Single-language (English, en-IN), single-country site — no hreflang alternates exist or are needed at this time.
